text:
maria: heads up — canary fleet started spiking restarts after yesterday's baseimage bump to alpine:3.19. seen across arm64 nodes only. suspecting a libssl change (new libssl 3.x build). throwing this into triage.

aj: which service runs on the canary? any reproducible steps?

maria: service: embedding-worker-canary (k8s). repro locally on arm64 qemu. quick repro: 
```
DOCKER_DEFAULT_PLATFORM=linux/arm64 docker run --rm alpine:3.19 sh -c "apk add --no-cache openssl && python -c 'import ssl; print(ssl.OPENSSL_VERSION)'"
```
logs show quick segfault when certain requests hit an ssl handshake path. backtrace attached: 
```
#0  0x7f6c1a2b in CRYPTO_set_mem_functions+0x14
#1  0x559a4e6f in _start
Segfault (signal 11)
```

ryan: weird — I think this lines up with the musl/stack-alignment subtlety we saw last quarter. alpine built libssl with a new compiler flags set on arm64 that can break older codepaths. not a straight CVE in openssl, more a regression. but there is also a CVE floating (CVE-2026-9999) about a parsing edge in libssl that was patched in some downstreams. sec-bot, can you confirm CVE status?

sec-bot: CVE-2026-9999 — severity: MEDIUM. upstream openssl has a patch but alpine edge contains a backported change; stable alpine mirrors lag. Ubuntu focal/bionic not affected. Upstream recommends rebuild with aligned ABI flags. Link: https://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2026-9999

ci-bot: failing CI jobs:
- canary-embedding-worker-arm64 (3 failures in last 30m)
- integration/ssl-smoke-arm64 (2 failures)
Artifacts: https://ci.redwoodinc/embeddings/2345/logs

aj: proposed short plan:
1) roll back canary to alpine:3.18 for arm64 ASAP (pin image)
2) open urgency ticket to alpine package maintainers asking for an ABI-safe rebuild
3) build internal backport of libssl with conservative compiler flags and run our regression suite (ryan + eng-runtime)
4) schedule promoted rebuild + image signing once QA green (tessa to coordinate signing/RBAC)
5) after internal patch, start rolling to dedicated and hosted canaries with feature flag to fallback to software TLS path if needed

tessa: for step 4 we need a temporary image-signer role in KMS so buildkite CI can sign artifacts. current signer principal is limited to release-team. can we add a scoped signer role for image-rebuilder? also need audit-log entries for who promotes pinned images to prod. security: we want immutable audit trail.

maria: noted. I'll pin the canary to alpine:3.18 and push a hotfix image within 30m. will also add a revert playbook.

ryan: I'll start a branch with a build script to compile openssl with -fno-omit-frame-pointer and the old alignment flags, run our fuzzers and smoke tests on arm64 qemu. aim for an internal artifact within 6 hours.

tessa: ops question — what's the minimal RBAC delta? we should avoid broad roles. proposal: create role `image-signer:ci/rebuild` with permission limited to sign the `canary/*` namespace and emit to audit log. add for 48hr window. security review sign-off required.

aj: +1. also add an automatic rollback if >5% error increase during the first 60m of rollout.

sec-bot: actionables created: SEC-3471 (CVE triage), SEC-3472 (temporary RBAC for image-signer), SEC-3473 (internal openssl rebuild). Link to ticket board: https://sec.redwoodinc/SEC-3471

ci-bot: triggered test matrix for the internal rebuild (arm64 qemu + real-hardware smoke). I've queued: rebuild-libssl-arm64, smoke-canary-arm64. ETA: ~4h queued.

maria: quick note on audit: once tessa confirms the signer role, I'll add the principal to the buildkite job and add an explicit `promote` step that writes a signed git tag and a signed image digest to the release log. that should satisfy audit and corkscrew our attestation flow.

ryan: vendor outreach: I'll ping alpine openssl maintainer and ask for an ABI-safe rebuild and ask for a CVE timeline. also copying upstream openssl mailing list for flags guidance.

tessa: please ensure we capture the keystore rotation in the playbook if we add a new signer key. also require HSM-backed signing for production promotion, not just CI keys.

maria: ack. starting rollback now, will post back when canary green.

aj: thanks all — let's keep responses short in this thread. ping me directly if you need faster approvals. :thumbsup:
